data.name: Ghayab
data.long_meaning: The name Ghayab is derived from the Arabic root 'gh-y-b'. It refers to something that is hidden, concealed, or absent. In Islamic context, Ghayab is often used to describe Allah’s unseen power and wisdom. This name carries deep spiritual significance and is a reminder of the hidden blessings and guidance from Allah.
